method: Blinded structural + read audit of the frozen 100-prompt Alpaca subset from prepare_blind_audit.py. Slot order is randomised per prompt; every structural statistic below was computed on the blinded file and only then unblinded. This is an agent-assisted qualitative read, not human labels and not a validated refusal classifier.
conclusion: On benign prompts the pre-repair arms do not refuse and do not truncate: exactly one of 100 responses opens with a refusal, and the arms hit the token cap on 6 prompts against base's 2, which is the long tail, not the short one. They compress. Answers keep the base model's structure, formatting and opening sentence, drop enumerated items and elaboration, and close with a well-formed summary -- shorter than base on 80 of 100 prompts, median 57% of base length. That is consistent with the observed downstream pattern (IFEval length/count constraints missed, GSM8K chains cut short, HarmBench harmful rate down, local RM proxy down) and it is not explained by the teacher: the solver's mass is on slightly LONGER candidates (teacher-weighted mean response length 219.8 tokens against 205.2 unweighted). The compression is introduced by the projection, not requested by the bargaining target.
caveat: canonN700 and RB1200 emit byte-identical greedy answers on 44 of 100 prompts, so they are not two independent arms for this comparison.

gsm8k_decomposition.reading: canonN700 loses 15.7 accuracy points against base. The extra format failures are 65 of 1319 items, so at most 4.9 points -- under a third of the drop -- can be parser failure even if every one of them would otherwise have been correct. At least 69% of the loss is arithmetic that is actually wrong, which is what a compressed chain of thought produces.

what_the_teacher_actually_prefers.caveat: Refusal here is the run's own keyword heuristic, labelled diagnostic-only by the artifact that produced it. It is not a validated refusal classifier and no claim rests on its absolute level -- only on the comparison between the pool and the teacher's mass within the same measure.
what_the_teacher_actually_prefers.reading: On every split the teacher's highest-mass candidate is longer than the pool average and refuses less often than it. Together with the within-prompt r^2 of length on the target (0.006/0.008/0.003), that closes the alternative explanation for the compression finding from three directions: the target does not track length, the teacher's mass does not move toward shorter answers, and its single best candidate moves the other way. What the projection produced is not what the target asked for.
